testedVersions: .NET 11; Microsoft Graph REST v1.0 synthetic HTTP fixtures only
prerequisites: Application.Read.All application consent in the declared tenant
Organization.Read.All application consent for tenant verification
limits: Public Graph cloud only; no live tenant validation
Metadata and explicit app-role assignments only, never effective SSO or access
No credentials, tokens, key material, contents or delegated OAuth grants

sections.refreshStrategy: Full paged read of visible application registrations
limits: Application object ID is not its client appId or a service-principal object ID
No app registration credentials, requested permissions or sign-in activity

sections.refreshStrategy: Full paged read of visible service principals
limits: Null or missing preferredSingleSignOnMode does not prove no SSO; older SAML and OIDC apps may report null
Application references by appId stay unresolved when the application is outside this environment
No credential, certificate, SAML payload or policy collection

sections.refreshStrategy: Page assignments for each visible resource service principal; preserve successful parents when another fails
limits: Explicit user, group and client service-principal assignments only; no group expansion or effective access
Unknown principal types retain a directoryObject reference and partial coverage
Role GUID only, not role definitions; zero appRoleId is the default assignment, not a missing role
Replication delay and incomplete visibility preclude negative evidence from omission
